annotations.title: Search Kalshi markets by title or keywords

description: Find Kalshi markets by title or keywords, the way the KalshiSpy app's search works (a team, a nickname or an approximate title works). WITHOUT an API key it returns SETTLED WINS ONLY: settled markets where KalshiSpy's roster of ID-verified, high-profit Kalshi traders held the winning side (wins only, never a hit rate). WITH an Elite or Lifetime API key the same call also returns OPEN markets in `open_markets`: roster positions and named traders' recent trades on still-open markets, and it costs 1 unit of the daily quota. Always read `data.access`: it says which answer you got and, when a key was refused, why; relay that sentence rather than guessing. Call this first whenever the user names a market in words, send the words under the argument name this tool's own schema gives, and cite each market's kalshi_url. An empty list is never evidence that Kalshi has no such market. For more wins, follow `settled_wins.more`, which carries ready-made search_settled_wins arguments.

limit.description: Maximum items in each list (settled wins, roster markets, recently traded markets).

query.description: Market title or keywords, e.g. "super bowl", "fed rate" or "bitcoin". Terms of 2+ characters, at most 8. All terms must match the title, outcome or tickers.

name: search_markets
title: Search Kalshi markets by title or keywords
